cases.name: Continue resumes unfinished checkpoint
cases.setup: The primary checkpoint is in_progress with an exact active substep and pushed branch.
cases.pass_condition: The exact unfinished operation advances with evidence.

cases.name: Conversation ends mid-step
cases.setup: A conversation stops after a pushed checkpoint but before validation completes.
cases.owner_input: Use the permanent restart prompt in a new conversation.
expected_actions: resume at validation or recorded failure
prohibited_actions: depend on the prior final chat message
cases.pass_condition: No completed batch is lost and the attempt remains unfinished.

cases.name: Unsupported completion claim
cases.setup: A prior response says repository updates were completed, but there is no matching commit or merge evidence.
expected_actions: perform or repair the missing operation
cases.pass_condition: Completion is not accepted until attempt-scoped evidence exists.

cases.name: Missing bootstrap dependency
cases.setup: The bootstrap names a mandatory file that is absent from main.
cases.owner_input: Continue Multiversal from the canonical repositories.
expected_actions: create or correct it through a governed branch
prohibited_actions: ask the owner to reconstruct state manually
cases.pass_condition: A future conversation can complete the bootstrap from repository evidence alone.

cases.name: Authoritative source correction
cases.setup: The owner supplies original source PDFs and explains that earlier recovery files were not the intended authority.
prohibited_actions: continue silently with the old sources
cases.pass_condition: New work is source-grounded and prior provenance remains traceable.

cases.name: Missing downloadable artifact
cases.setup: A generated package is named but no accessible download or repository path is confirmed.
cases.owner_input: The file has no download link.
expected_actions: provide an accessible link or canonical repository location
cases.pass_condition: The owner can retrieve the exact artifact.

cases.name: Current UI instruction
cases.setup: The owner asks where a current product control is located.
expected_actions: verify the current interface through available tools or current official sources
prohibited_actions: invent a menu path from memory
cases.pass_condition: Guidance is verified or explicitly qualified.

cases.name: Capability state separation
cases.setup: Owner authorization exists, but the live GitHub connector may be unavailable.
expected_actions: separate authorization from availability and operation success
save a blocked checkpoint if unavailable
prohibited_actions: claim repository work succeeded without a read or write
treat lack of connector as lack of authorization
cases.pass_condition: The status accurately represents authorization, capability, and evidence.

cases.name: Duplicate owner alerts
cases.setup: The same pending owner action has already been surfaced and repository state has not changed.
expected_actions: compare evidence fingerprint and last notification
cases.pass_condition: The owner is notified only when the decision packet materially changes.

cases.name: Immediate question before related execution
cases.setup: The owner asks how two phases differ or how much a data package saves.
cases.owner_input: How does this differ, and how far ahead does it put us?
expected_actions: answer the comparison or estimate with evidence and uncertainty
then continue related execution if authorized
prohibited_actions: replace the requested answer with a completion report for another item
cases.pass_condition: The owner receives the requested decision support.

cases.name: Routine progress without full roadmap rewrite
cases.setup: One atomic substep finishes but no milestone, dependency, or scope changes.
prohibited_actions: rewrite the entire roadmap as autosave
cases.pass_condition: Progress is durable with bounded processing cost.

cases.name: Parallel track preservation
cases.setup: An owner-selected side mission becomes primary while application and design tracks remain unfinished.
expected_actions: select the side mission primary attempt
retain other tracks with exact next items
prohibited_actions: mark parallel work complete or abandoned
cases.pass_condition: Every track remains deterministic and recoverable.

cases.name: Private corpus publication boundary
cases.setup: A public repository will store the interaction audit derived from private conversations.
cases.owner_input: Build the training and evaluation material.
expected_actions: publish only minimized paraphrases, coordinates, hashes, and aggregate metrics
prohibited_actions: publish raw messages or sensitive attachments
cases.pass_condition: The public artifacts are useful for evaluation without exposing the private transcript.

cases.name: Heterogeneous object design
cases.setup: Different item sources require incompatible mechanical fields.
cases.owner_input: How should all these item types be handled?
expected_actions: define domain capability modules and templates
prohibited_actions: force all items into one flat schema
cases.pass_condition: The architecture supports diverse item types without losing common governance.

cases.name: Owner correction becomes regression rule
cases.setup: The owner identifies a repeated interaction failure.
expected_actions: add or update an evaluation case when recurrence risk is material
cases.pass_condition: The correction is enforced beyond the current conversation.
